title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Operational Guidelines
issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
document_text:
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)
OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES

1. OBJECTIVE: The scheme aims to augment the income of all landholding farmers' families in the country.

2. BENEFIT: Under the scheme, an amount of Rs. 6,000/- per year is transferred directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiary farmer families in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000/- each.

3. ELIGIBILITY: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible. The cut-off date for determination of eligibility of beneficiaries was 01.02.2019.

4. EXCLUSIONS: The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not be eligible:
(a) All Institutional Landholders.
(b) Farmer families in which one or more members belong to the following categories: Former and present holders of constitutional posts; Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs; All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries and PSUs; All Persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year; Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants.

5. MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS: Aadhaar authentication is mandatory for receiving benefits. Bank accounts must be Aadhaar-seeded with active e-KYC. Land ownership records (7/12 or RoR) must be authenticated by the State Revenue Department.
